name: Sikkim State Data Centre upgrade
developer: Department of Information Technology, Government of Sikkim
notes: Government tender dated 2025-03-05 sought an agency to prepare the DPR for a next-generation Sikkim State Data Centre; 2025 Independence Day government remarks said plans were underway to upgrade the State Data Centre and extend connectivity to unserved districts. Tender venue is Department of Information Technology, Sonam Tshering Marg, Gangtok; capacity not disclosed.

name: NIC-Sikkim Data Centre / small state-capital data centre
notes: NIC Sikkim describes the NIC-Sikkim Data Centre as operational since August 2021 and providing PaaS/IaaS services for e-governance; NIC Sikkim's data-centres service page says NIC has small data centres at various state capitals for round-the-clock government services. Capacity not disclosed.
